changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [queue].[WriteIndexXml] ( @Action varchar(15), @ActionObject varchar(50), @ActionObjectID int, @ResourceID int ) RETURNS varchar(250) AS BEGIN RETURN '<fields> <Action>' + @Action + '</Action> <ActionObject>' + @ActionObject + '</ActionObject> <ActionObjectID>' + cast(@ActionObjectID as varchar) + '</ActionObjectID> <ResourceID>' + cast(@ResourceID as varchar) + '</ResourceID> </fields>' END
